attchmntText: Rentomojo Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
voiceSummary: Rentomojo Limited filed a statement of deviation for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, confirming no deviation in the utilization of IPO proceeds. The company raised 1,500.00 million rupees during the issue period from September 9, 2026, to September 11, 2026. Funds utilized during the quarter totaled 929.80 million rupees. This included 700.00 million rupees for repayment of borrowings, 80.98 million rupees for warehouse lease rentals, 119.02 million rupees for general corporate purposes, and 29.80 million rupees for issue expenses. The Audit Committee reviewed the statement on November 10, 2026. Crisil Ratings Limited issued a monitoring agency report on November 12, 2026. Unutilized proceeds of 570.20 million rupees were deployed in fixed deposits with RBL Bank Limited and Axis Bank Limited, with balances held in public issue and monitoring accounts at ICICI Bank Limited.

attchmntText: Rentomojo Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
voiceSummary: Rentomojo Limited has made the audio recording of its Q2 FY27 Earnings Conference Call available on its website. The call was held on November 12, 2026, at 4:00 P.M. IST. This disclosure is pursuant to Regulation 30 of SEBI Listing Regulations. The audio file can be accessed via the provided link on the company website. The intimation was issued by Deepika Bhandiwad, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer.

attchmntText: Rentomojo Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
voiceSummary: Rentomojo Limited filed a Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, issued by Crisil Ratings Limited. The company raised Rs 1,500.00 million through an Initial Public Offer. Net proceeds were Rs 1,413.72 million. Rs 929.80 million was utilized during the quarter. Rs 700.00 million repaid outstanding borrowings. Rs 80.98 million paid lease rentals for warehouses and experience stores. Rs 119.02 million funded general corporate purposes. Rs 29.80 million covered issue expenses. Rs 570.20 million remains unutilized. Unutilized funds are invested in fixed deposits and bank balances. No deviations from the offer document objects were reported. The Board of Directors approved the general corporate purpose utilization on November 10, 2026.

attchmntText: Rentomojo Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
voiceSummary: Rentomojo Limited published newspaper advertisements for its unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026. The advertisements appeared in the Financial Express and Vishwavani newspapers on November 12, 2026. The filings were submitted to BSE Limited and National Stock Exchange of India Limited under Regulation 47 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations 2015. The documents include a QR code and details for accessing complete results on the company website at www.rentomojo.com. Deepika Bhandiwad, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, signed the communication. The exchange was requested to take the information on record.

attchmntText: Rentomojo Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 11, 2026, titled "Press release ".
voiceSummary: Rentomojo reported unaudited consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30 September 2026. Revenue from Operations increased 52.8% year-on-year to 1,421 million rupees in Q2 FY27. Normalised EBITDA rose 52.7% to 588 million rupees, and Normalised PAT grew 52.2% to 240 million rupees. Gross Items Ordered by Customers increased 45.0% to 381,347. For H1 FY27, Revenue from Operations grew 52.0% to 2,684 million rupees. Operating cash flow for H1 FY27 stood at 1,100 million rupees. The company listed on the NSE and BSE on 17 September 2026 following its Initial Public Offering. Net worth increased to 4,662 million rupees. Debt-to-equity improved to 0.50x. The company operated 96 Experience Stores across 14 cities as of 30 September 2026.

attchmntText: Rentomojo Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates - Investor presentation on Q2 & H1 FY27
voiceSummary: Rentomojo Limited released its Q2 and H1 FY27 investor presentation. The company listed shares on the NSE and BSE on 17 September 2026 at an issue price of Rs. 404. The total issue size was Rs. 12,556 million, comprising a fresh issue of Rs. 1,500 million and an offer for sale of Rs. 11,056 million. For Q2 FY27, revenue from operations grew 52.8% year-on-year to Rs. 1,421 million. Normalised EBITDA increased 52.7% to Rs. 588 million, and normalised PAT rose 52.2% to Rs. 240 million. Items ordered reached 3,81,347, up 45.0% year-on-year. Net proceeds from the fresh issue were Rs. 1,414 million. As of September 2026, net worth stood at Rs. 4,662 million, and net debt reduced to Rs. 1,306 million.

attchmntText: Rentomojo Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Rentomojo Limited approved unaudited financial results for Q2 FY 2026-27 ending September 30, 2026. Standalone revenue was Rs. 1,421.13 million, with a net profit of Rs. 181.93 million. Basic earnings per share stood at Rs. 1.84. The Board also approved remuneration revisions for Executive Director Ketan Krishna, DIN 09032220, and other Key Managerial Persons, effective April 1, 2026. Designation changes were approved for Rohan Ajeet Kulkarni and Prabhat Verma, effective November 10, 2026. CRISIL Ratings Limited confirmed no deviation in the utilization of issue proceeds for the quarter. The Board meeting concluded at 7:31 P.M. on November 10, 2026.
